lede.zh: 本报告呈现 GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 在 MI308X 上已完成的短输入服务矩阵、开放环到达测试，以及原始 ROCm 路径的长上下文兼容性结果。
lede.en: This report presents completed short-input and open-loop measurements for GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 on MI308X, plus long-context compatibility results for the original ROCm path.

snapshot.zh: 短输入矩阵 · 开放环到达率 · Agent · 上下文故障边界
snapshot.en: Short-input matrix · open-loop arrivals · Agent · context-failure boundary

heading.zh: 通过点与故障边界同时披露
heading.en: Passing points and failure boundaries are both reported

intro.zh: 短输入服务矩阵可完成；输入扩展超过约 2,040 tokens 后，原始 vLLM ROCm 引擎会在特定 FP8 sparse-indexer 路径崩溃。故障后长上下文与多模态并发档不计作零吞吐。
intro.en: The short-input matrix completes. Beyond roughly 2,040 input tokens, the original vLLM ROCm engine crashes in a specific FP8 sparse-indexer path. Long-context and multimodal concurrency points after the crash are not treated as zero throughput.

note.zh: 开放环每档为单次 600 请求；短输入容量点也是单次测量。某些分位数样本量低于 128，只作为观测值。主报告仅对应原始 FP8 vLLM ROCm 路径。
note.en: Each open-loop rate is one 600-request run; short-input points are also single runs. Some quantiles have fewer than 128 samples and are observations only. This report covers the original FP8 vLLM ROCm path.

heading.zh: 短输入场景可运行，固定长度与自然请求吞吐各不相同
heading.en: Short-input profiles run successfully, with distinct rates for fixed and natural requests

intro.zh: 8×MI308X、TP8、vLLM ROCm nightly；FP8 checkpoint。主矩阵单次测量；Agent 为 BFCL v3 工具调用轨迹。
intro.en: Eight MI308X accelerators, TP8, vLLM ROCm nightly; FP8 checkpoint. Primary matrix is single-run; Agent uses BFCL v3 tool-call traces.

notes.zh: BFCL Agent 128 请求并发 8，输出吞吐 245.7 tok/s；不表示 BFCL pass rate。
notes.en: BFCL Agent used 128 requests at concurrency 8 and reached 245.7 output tok/s; this is not a BFCL pass rate.

heading.zh: 长输入 512/256 到达压测的吞吐随到达率上升
heading.en: Throughput rises with arrival rate for 512/256 open-loop traffic

intro.zh: 每档 600 次请求，单轮测试；在同一模型、TP8、vLLM 配置下递增到达率。
intro.en: 600 requests per rate, single run; arrival rate is increased with the same model, TP8, and vLLM setup.

notes.zh: 12.2 req/s 档成功率 100%，但 TTFT P95 已达 5.51 s；不能只根据输出 tok/s 判断可服务负载。
notes.en: The 12.2 req/s point has 100% success but TTFT P95 reaches 5.51 s; output tok/s alone does not define a serviceable load.

title.zh: 到达率与实际输出吞吐

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

heading.zh: 原始 vLLM ROCm 路径在约 2K 输入处触发引擎崩溃
heading.en: The original vLLM ROCm path crashes beyond roughly 2K input tokens

intro.zh: 长度探测每档启动独立引擎；4K 档 16/16 请求失败并触发引擎崩溃，16K、64K、256K 和 1M 档均未执行。原始源记录定位到 gfx942 FlyDSL FP8 sparse-indexer JIT 路径。
intro.en: Length probes used a fresh engine per point. The 4K point failed all 16 requests and crashed the engine; 16K, 64K, 256K, and 1M points were not executed. Source notes locate the failure in the gfx942 FlyDSL FP8 sparse-indexer JIT path.

notes.zh: aiter 补丁实验属于偏离原配方的独立分支，不在此图中混合为原始路径的成功结果。该修复分支长上下文精度门未通过。
notes.en: The aiter-patched experiment is a separate, recipe-divergent branch and is not merged into this chart as a successful result for the original path. Its long-context quality gate did not pass.

rows: 前序崩溃后引擎已退出

heading.zh: 短上下文工具调用可测，多模态与长上下文受引擎故障限制
heading.en: Short-context tool calls are measurable; multimodal and long-context tests are limited by the engine failure

intro.zh: Agent 使用 BFCL v3，128 请求、并发 8。多模态 c1 通过；c8 在 25 条成功后引擎崩溃，后续点未完成。
intro.en: Agent uses BFCL v3, 128 requests, concurrency 8. Multimodal C1 passed; C8 crashed after 25 successful requests, and later points did not complete.

notes.zh: Agent 吞吐为 245.7 tok/s，报告不推断工具任务通过率。多模态部分结果不作为完整并发容量数据。
notes.en: Agent throughput is 245.7 tok/s; no tool-task pass rate is inferred. Partial multimodal results are not treated as a complete concurrency-capacity result.

rows: throughput only; task score not inferred

methodIntro.zh: 8×MI308X、TP8；原始 vLLM ROCm nightly 配方路径。长上下文错误发生于 gfx942 专属算子构建路径。
methodIntro.en: Eight MI308X accelerators, TP8; original vLLM ROCm nightly recipe path. The long-context failure occurs in a gfx942-specific operator build path.

methodNotes.zh: 修复分支使用独立的 aiter 补丁构建，且长上下文 needle 精度门未通过；不作为原始配置性能数据。
methodNotes.en: A patched aiter build was tested separately and did not pass the long-context needle quality gate; it is excluded from original-configuration performance data.

methodNotes.zh: 上游兼容性状态会随软件修复变化；本报告只说明 2026 年 9 月记录的这一环境。
methodNotes.en: Upstream compatibility may change with software fixes; this report describes the environment measured in September 2026.

methodNotes.zh: 机器地址、日志路径、原始请求和内部构建标识均未公开。
methodNotes.en: Machine addresses, log paths, raw requests, and internal build identifiers are omitted.
